title: 1RB0LE_0RC0RA_1RD1RF_1LA0LD_1LD0RF_1RB---: all 54 copy ticks proved in Lean, and the first rounds as rules
text: The three copy ticks that were left copy the block Y between two separators 1 instead of X: for the front 3|1|Y it is the whole tick, and in one tick it happens inside the first rounds. Lean proves both with the same loop, so all 54 copy ticks of the first 10<sup>10</sup> steps, and with the front rules 252 of the 258 left-end ticks, now have a Lean proof. The first rounds of a copy also turn out to be left-end ticks, of F.3, and with six more turn shapes and one local piece, 2,087 of the 2,094 copy rounds of the run follow from rules for every front of their shape.
